figures.title: An immune-treatment-associated atlas
figures.caption: a, All 2,670,057 archived cells at unchanged atlas UMAP coordinates, shuffled drawing order. b, 199,998 study-balanced display cells, seed 20261014; counts in c and eligibility in d use every cell. Study colours match cohort bars. Endpoint eligibility is source-specific and does not count independent patients. Major labels include proposals, unresolved and boundary categories. UMAP fit used 100,000 landmarks and transformed the remaining 2,570,057 cells.

figures.title: Composition and multigene identity evidence
figures.caption: All archived cells contribute to composition and marker statistics. Dot area is the positive fraction among cells in sources that measured that gene; colour is log1p(mean native chosen-count CP10K), scaled to each gene maximum across displayed rows. Unmeasured genes remain missing. Capture-biased composition is descriptive. Proposals require multigene review; naming markers alone are not definitive identities.

figures.title: T: descriptive subclusters
figures.caption: 1,571,352 archived T cells and 16 descriptive nodes; 188,453 node-balanced display points, seed 20261014, in the original atlas UMAP (no new lineage embedding). Numerical labels identify catalog numbers; labels are moved with leader lines for legibility while data coordinates stay unchanged. Complete labels and full-cell expression evidence are in the dotplot. Colour is relative per-gene log mean CP10K; area is detection/measured fraction. Fine candidates remain unpromoted; stress/sex markers are descriptors.

figures.title: Continuous T-cell state axes
figures.caption: Five saved native panel-score axes, 145,326 study-balanced T display cells. Each score colour range runs from zero to its all-T-cell 99th percentile; saturation is visual only. The heatmap uses all 1,571,352 T cells and descriptive node means standardized separately within each axis, clipped visually at ±2. Scores are state axes, not mutually exclusive cell types or treatment-response tests.

figures.title: Malignancy candidates and evaluation scope
figures.caption: All-cell atlas CNV states and source-specific cell counts; original-library methods, not cell counts, define panel c. Panel d shows each evaluable library median candidate burden divided by its own reference median (log2), with library median across points as black line; no new threshold or hypothesis test. 52,657 single-method supported malignant candidates, 57,958 uncertain cells. Skips and negative candidates do not establish normal identity.

figures.title: CM scope: whole_TME
figures.caption: Actual saved whole_TME nsNMF, 80 nodes, rank 2, 2 factors with supported network members. Rows are the union of top loading nodes per factor (three per factor for K>4, eight otherwise), at most 36 readable rows; all rows remain in saved W. W is scaled by factor mass; source median H contributions use matching inverse scaling, then within-block fractions. Blocks include explicitly exploratory unverified libraries where applicable. Numeric network labels refer to catalog node numbers; marker names appear in loading rows or the full catalog. Network edges are saved source-adjusted composition correlations after original FDR/specificity/support gates; layout is illustrative, not spatial or ligand-receptor evidence. Rank-boundary/LOSO-unestimable results remain in source reports. No new clinical tests.

figures.title: Complete CM discovery scope
figures.caption: All 15 completed composition scopes: 10 have supported network-member modules, five do not; another six prepared scopes were insufficient. Selected NMF rank and supported-member module count are distinct. Scopes overlap and their ranks must not be summed as independent modules. No unsupported result is hidden.

figures.title: Batch and biological structure diagnostics
figures.caption: Identical 199,998 study-balanced display cells before and after Harmony in the first two component coordinates, not a before/after UMAP. All RNA counts remain unchanged. The original 10,000-cell neighbor diagnostic reported entropy 0.4127→0.8077 and marker-proposal purity 0.8223→0.8136; these are descriptive indicators, not a ground-truth annotation or proof of absent overcorrection.

figures.title: Available depth and correction provenance
figures.caption: Left: per-original-library medians of the complete native chosen-count denominator; points are libraries and black segments are study medians. Right: full-cell correction-adopted and primary-fit exclusion fractions. This is available provenance, not a replacement for source QC; original mitochondrial/nGene fields are not universally available and have not been fabricated. Prior-QC sources without new ambient assessment retain their documented status.

figures.title: Every cohort in the shared atlas coordinates
figures.caption: All nine sources, each with unchanged common UMAP limits. Up to 60,000 major-balanced display points per source, seed 20261014, preserving rare observed classes; this sampling is not used for composition proportions. Titles map to GEO IDs and the CAR-T CXG source in the cohort registry.
